_doc: Shrink-only accepted-list of released versions whose tag is present but points OUTSIDE the published history (GHI #829). Seeded 2026-08-18 at the population measured on main. Every entry is a legitimate release orphaned by the 2026-04-19 filter-repo rewrite and force-push named in AGENTS.md Local Agent Rules -- the tags survived, their commits did not, so reachability from refs/remotes/origin/main is unprovable for them by construction. The boundary is exact and was measured, not assumed: v0.25.11 (2026-04-18 20:12) is unreachable, v0.25.12 (2026-04-19 06:37) is reachable, and every version on either side follows. An entry exempts a version from the REACHABILITY arm ONLY -- the tag must still exist, so a deleted historical tag is still refused. NEVER add an entry to silence a release tagged after the cutover; retag at the commit that landed and push it, which is the GHI #828 repair. The list is shrink-only: entries are surrendered, never added. Enforced by src/gzkit/governance/trust_audits/release.py::audit_version_release.

measurement.population_derivation: Versions = every `## vX.Y.Z` heading in RELEASE_NOTES.md, the operator-facing declaration of what shipped. Reachability = `git merge-base --is-ancestor v<ver>^{commit} refs/remotes/origin/main`, a local check; GHI #205 scoped network out of this audit.
measurement.note: v0.7.0 is NOT in this list despite predating the rewrite. Its tag was local-only and pointed at an unpushed orphan; GHI #828 retagged it at 61f04d138, the surviving post-rewrite commit carrying the identical tree, so it is genuinely reachable and needs no exemption.
